communication.notifyOn: blocker, risk, scope-or-authorization-change, user-decision, failed-verification, state-transition
communication.guidance: Use one short kickoff that combines skill, reason, scope, boundaries, and next action. Do not narrate routine UI-visible tool activity or repeat unchanged boundaries. Later commentary must add a new material fact unless it is a one-sentence host-required heartbeat.

runtimeOwnership: Codex owns scheduling, delegation, concurrency, cancellation, and model selection; Harness records dependencies, ownership, verification, and candidate evidence

parallelSafety.requirement: parallel writers require separate locked worktrees/cwds; otherwise concurrent nodes must be read-only or have proven non-overlapping file ownership

nodes.label: Batch 1 Storage Interface
nodes.ownership: current control task only: shared storage interface, SQLite adapter, and contract tests
nodes.expectedOutput: SQLite-compatible storage abstraction with non-zero CRUD contract tests and accepted node evidence
nodes.stopConditions: SQLite behavior/data path changes, unrelated scope growth, credentials, destructive commands, or failed contract verification

nodes.label: Batch 2 YAML Backend
nodes.ownership: current control task only: YAML codec/backend, strict validation, recovery backup, atomic writes, and file-integrity tests; no UI
nodes.expectedOutput: strict recoverable YAML backend with non-zero codec, safety, concurrency, failure, and restart tests
nodes.stopConditions: unprovable recovery/atomic safety, secret persistence, UI integration before validation, credentials, or destructive commands

nodes.label: Batch 3 Application Integration
nodes.ownership: current control task only: backend/path settings, temporary YAML passwords, and explicit verified copy-and-switch
nodes.expectedOutput: registered IPC and focused settings UI with safe copy/switch behavior and frontend/backend verification
nodes.stopConditions: automatic migration, source deletion, non-empty target overwrite, secret persistence, or failed batch verification

nodes.label: Batch 4 Integration And Docs
nodes.ownership: current control task only: integrated local acceptance, documentation/version consistency, and final state-sync evidence
nodes.expectedOutput: fresh full test/build evidence, consistent docs/version metadata, satisfied Goal checklist/gates, and validated-local state sync
nodes.stopConditions: failing required verification, unverifiable rollback/data safety, real SSH/credential/release need, or product-direction conflict
